design.grammar: Seed QualityTerm := ar | aiin | orar | oraiin | or QualityTerm. Prefix free-token or has exactly one Quality argument; each compound is one exact terminal licensed by its displayed derivation. This is an explicitly incomplete lexicon, not a whole-text grammar. A prospective extension must separately enumerate every added typed whole value or operator before testing, without changing the four-case OPPOSITE table. No other segmentation, implicit conversion to a proposition, or covert conjunction is licensed.
actual_two_inputs_and_composition: ar -> orar gives COLD; aiin -> oraiin gives DRY.
N.2 or or aiin derives OPPOSITE(OPPOSITE(MOISTURE)) = MOISTURE in all three readers.
N.4 oraiin derives DRY. ZL W.20 and ZL/RF W.22 or aiin derive the same DRY Quality object, so fused/separated occurrences constrain one denotation.
predicted_consequences: Two applications restore MOISTURE, whereas one application yields DRY; neither entails whether any particular person is moist or dry.

Every free or occurrence consumes a QualityTerm. Thus or ain atW.20 requires ain to receive a Quality denotation if this local application is used; or shedy atS.13, or am atS.15 and or airol/air at.24 impose comparable explicit type pressures.
